title: Deployment pocket cheatlist - private/VPC installs
content:
Morning quick log (short, messy)

Context: onsite prep for AcmeHealth VPC install next week. Customer environment notes from last call + items that always bite us. This is a personal pocket list — toss into ticket INF-4821 as follow-ups after lift.

Today goals:
- Re-run preflight container on staging image (tag: v0.9.3-rc2) and capture logs
- Confirm KMS wrap key rotation window with infra team (Ava) — they asked for 48h overlap
- Draft short runbook snippet for customer to open firewall ports (minimal)

Preflight checklist (quick commands & expectations)
- linux kernel: check sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 (sometimes disabled by default on hardened AMIs)
  - cmd: sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward || echo NEED
- cgroups: ensure systemd uses cgroup v1 compatibility for our runtime (ask SRE if RHEL8 with cgroup v2)
  - cmd: ls /sys/fs/cgroup || echo CHECK_CGROUP
- SELinux: permissive or disabled recommended for installer run (we document re-enable later)
  - cmd: getenforce || echo SELINUX_UNKNOWN
- DNS: customer internal DNS must resolve s3-endpoints used for model downloads (ask them for VPC endpoint or NAT egress)
- NTP/time sync: critical — drifting clocks break cert validation during handshake

Common customer blockers (have seen these repeatedly)
- Split tunnel VPN + private subnets: agents can't reach model download hosts -> recommend temporary NAT gateway or S3 VPC endpoint
- Corporate proxy with MITM TLS appliance: must provide CA cert for installer VM trust store (we need PEM, not just root cert)
- KMS / HSM policy: customer wants to manage keys; confirm our service principal principal ARN and allowed actions (Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey)
- Egress policies: many embed rules that block 443 to public model hosting — prepare fallback build with models pre-pulled (artifact idea)

Customer-specific reminders (AcmeHealth)
- They require all third-party binaries to be hashed and approved by security team (ask them for hash acceptance timeline)
- No outbound SSH to internet from host network. Must stage jumpbox in customer mgmt subnet, with bastion user list (Jonah to confirm)
- PCI scope clarification: they want inference to be out of scope; our data-in-transit handling doc updated? Add short summary to handoff

Quick install notes (installer v0.9.3-rc2)
1) bootstrap VM: 8 vCPU, 32GB RAM, NVMe instance recommended for caching large models (customer wants GPU later)
2) pre-install: apt update; install jq, curl, socat. Ensure python3.10 present
3) run installer: curl -sSf https://installer.redwood.local/bootstrap.sh | bash -s -- --mode vpc --manifest /tmp/site-manifest.yaml
4) watch logs: journalctl -u redwood-installer -f (if using systemd) or ./installer/logs/latest.log
5) if model fetch fails: check /var/lib/redwood/cache permissions and user id mapping (we map to redwood:1001)

Debug shortcuts
- If we see 403 from S3 model fetch: check IAM role attached to node, then proxy cert chain if present
- KV-cache mismatch after restart: clear /var/lib/redwood/kvcache/* and restart runtime (sometimes stale shards)

Notes for post-install handoff doc
- Minimal firewall rules (outbound 443, DNS, NTP; inbound only 22 from bastion and port 8080 to internal APIGW)
- Rolling restart procedure (how to drain worker, warm cache, re-add) — short script snippet to include
- Telemetry: explain what we collect (latency, token counts, error rates) and retention period default (30d)

Open questions / TODOs (to move into INF-4821)
- Can AcmeHealth allow S3 VPC endpoint? If not, we need to provide pre-pulled model tarball and steps to host locally
- Confirm whether customer KMS requires external HSM attestation (if yes, schedule security call)
- License key expiry window: ask product for grace behavior when license rotates mid-session

Random scratch bits (notes to self)
- Bring USB-C power adapter tomorrow (local coffee shop laptop death last time)
- Print one-sheet preflight for security team (include CA fingerprint and installer SHA256)
- Check installer PR #78 for updated --no-telemetry flag (might be required by Acme security)

End-of-day quick status: re-run preflight on staging -> found SELinux in enforcing on one AMI (need to document workaround), opened INF-4821 with initial checklist, pinged Ava about KMS rotation.

If time: draft the minimal firewall doc and get Jonah to sanity-check bastion user list.

-- Ravi
